summary: Cas confronts Rio in an abandoned subway tunnel about why he traded her safety for Dawna's, why he didn't kill her to infiltrate Dawna's group, and why he told her not to get involved. Rio refuses to explain and walks away, leaving Cas frustrated. Cas then goes to meet Steve at an empty construction site, where he looks worn down and exhausted.
one_line: Cas confronts Rio in a dark subway tunnel over his unexplained choices and protection, then meets a haggard Steve at a construction site.
key_facts: Rio traded Cas's safety for Dawna's, and Cas says this was not the first time he did so.
Back when Dawna had Arthur and Cas, Rio was trying to take down Pithica and had the perfect opportunity to kill Cas and gain Dawna's trust.
Cas says Rio could have killed her, secured Dawna's trust, and destroyed them from the inside out, but Rio instead broke them out.
Dawna Polk once called Cas an anomaly, and Cas feels bothered that Dawna seems to understand Rio's relationship with Cas better than Cas does.
Rio tells Cas that he had other considerations and that she was not aware of them.
Rio refuses to answer Cas's questions and advises her to stop asking them.
Rio tells Cas at the beginning not to get involved, and when asked why, says he didn't want her involved.
Cas says she has a right to know, and Rio responds that she might disagree with that.
Rio tips his hat to Cas and walks away down the darkened subway tracks, leaving her shouting at the empty air.
Cas has one more meeting that day, which she hopes will be more satisfactory.
Steve meets Cas at an empty construction site.
Steve has several days' worth of five o'clock shadow on his square jaw and deep purple shadows under his eyes.
